title: Radicals: reading the parts
focus: Common meaning radicals (氵 口 扌 亻 讠 艹 女 木 心/忄 钅) and sound components (马 妈 吗 骂; 青 清 请 晴) to guess unknown characters.
body:
# Radicals: reading the parts

Most characters are built from two parts: a **radical** that hints at the meaning, and a **sound component** that hints at the pronunciation. You already know thousands of words by ear, so this is your best tool: when you see an unknown character, use the radical to guess the topic, use the sound part to guess the syllable, then pick the word you know that fits the sentence.

For example, 晴 = 日 (sun) + 青 (qīng). Something about the weather that sounds like qing: 晴天 qíngtiān, a sunny day.

| Radical | Meaning | Seen in |
|---|---|---|
| 氵 | water | 汽 洗 澡 清 汤 |
| 口 | mouth, sound | 吃 喝 叫 唱 吗 |
| 扌 | hand | 抱 打 找 |
| 亻 | person | 他 们 住 休 做 |
| 讠 | speech | 说 话 请 记 |
| 艹 | plant | 花 茶 菜 |
| 女 | woman | 妈 姐 妹 奶 姓 |
| 木 | tree, wood | 树 林 |
| 心 忄 | heart, feelings, mind | 想 忘 快 怕 情 |
| 钅 | metal, money | 钱 银 |

| Sound part | Family |
|---|---|
| 马 mǎ | 妈 mā · 吗 ma · 骂 mà · 码 mǎ |
| 青 qīng | 清 qīng · 请 qǐng · 晴 qíng · 情 qíng · 睛 jīng |
| 包 bāo | 饱 bǎo · 抱 bào · 跑 pǎo |

The sound part usually gets you the syllable but not always the tone, and sometimes only a near rhyme (睛 jīng). That is close enough to jog your memory of the word.

## Examples

- 请喝水。 qǐng hē shuǐ: Please have some water.
- 请你说清楚。 qǐng nǐ shuō qīngchu: Please say it clearly.
- 今天是晴天。 jīntiān shì qíngtiān: It's sunny today.
- 我吃饱了。 wǒ chībǎo le: I'm full.
- 他跑了! tā pǎo le: He ran off!
- 妈妈骂他了。 māma mà tā le: Mom told him off.
- 快来! kuài lái: Come quick!
- 我忘记他的号码了。 wǒ wàngjì tā de hàomǎ le: I forgot his number.
- 爷爷每天都喝茶。 yéye měitiān dōu hē chá: Grandpa drinks tea every day.
- 他在树下睡觉。 tā zài shù xià shuìjiào: He's sleeping under the tree.

## Common mistakes

- **Same sound part, different radical.** 情 (feeling, 忄), 晴 (sunny, 日), 请 (please, 讠) and 清 (clear, 氵) all sound like qing. Look at the left side to tell them apart.
- **讠 vs 氵.** 讠 (speech) is one hooked stroke; 氵 (water) is three dots.

cards.Example: 我喜欢马。 wǒ xǐhuan mǎ: I like horses.
cards.Notes: The sound part in 妈 mā, 吗 ma, 骂 mà, 码 mǎ

cards.Example: 妈妈骂他了。 māma mà tā le: Mom told him off.
cards.Notes: Two 口 mouths over 马 mǎ for the sound

cards.Example: 这是我的号码。 zhè shì wǒ de hàomǎ: This is my number.
cards.Notes: 码 = 石 stone + 马 mǎ for the sound

cards.Example: 请喝水。 qǐng hē shuǐ: Please have some water.
cards.Notes: 讠 speech + 青 qīng: polite words

cards.Example: 我听不清楚。 wǒ tīng bu qīngchu: I can't hear clearly.
cards.Notes: 清 = 氵 water + 青 qīng: clear like water

cards.Example: 今天是晴天。 jīntiān shì qíngtiān: It's sunny today.
cards.Notes: 晴 = 日 sun + 青 qīng for the sound

cards.Example: 这个事情我知道。 zhège shìqing wǒ zhīdào: I know about this.
cards.Notes: 情 = 忄 heart + 青; 情 and 晴 differ only in the radical

cards.Example: 她的眼睛大大的。 tā de yǎnjing dàdà de: She has big eyes.
cards.Notes: Both have 目 eye: 眼 = 目 + 艮, 睛 = 目 + 青

cards.Meaning: to hug, hold in your arms
cards.Example: 抱一下! bào yíxià: Give me a hug!
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 包 bāo for the sound

cards.Example: 我吃饱了。 wǒ chībǎo le: I'm full.
cards.Notes: 饣 food + 包 bāo for the sound

cards.Example: 他跑了! tā pǎo le: He ran off!
cards.Notes: 足 foot + 包 bāo, sound shifted to pǎo

cards.Meaning: to take a bath or shower
cards.Example: 弟弟在洗澡。 dìdi zài xǐzǎo: Little brother's in the shower.
cards.Notes: Both have 氵 water: 洗 = 氵 + 先 xiān, 澡 = 氵 + 喿 zào

cards.Example: 我要喝汽水。 wǒ yào hē qìshuǐ: I want a soda.
cards.Notes: 汽 = 氵 water + 气 qì (air, gas): steam, fizz

cards.Example: 妈妈叫你。 māma jiào nǐ: Mom's calling you.
cards.Notes: 口 mouth on the left: things you do with your voice

cards.Example: 她喜欢唱歌。 tā xǐhuan chànggē: She likes singing.
cards.Notes: 唱 = 口 + 昌 chāng; 歌 = 哥 gē + 欠 (open mouth)

cards.Example: 我住在这儿。 wǒ zhù zài zhèr: I live here.
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 主 zhǔ; 住 vs 往 (wǎng): 往 has the double-person 彳

cards.Example: 你休息一下。 nǐ xiūxi yíxià: Take a rest.
cards.Notes: 休 = 亻 person leaning against 木 tree; 息 has 心 heart underneath

cards.Example: 他不说话。 tā bù shuōhuà: He won't talk.
cards.Notes: Both have 讠 speech; 话 = 讠 + 舌 tongue

cards.Example: 这是妈妈买的花。 zhè shì māma mǎi de huā: These are flowers Mom bought.
cards.Notes: 艹 plant + 化 huà for the sound

cards.Example: 爷爷每天都喝茶。 yéye měitiān dōu hē chá: Grandpa drinks tea every day.
cards.Notes: 艹 leaves on top, 木 a bush at the bottom

cards.Example: 她姓马。 tā xìng mǎ: Her surname is Ma.
cards.Notes: 女 + 生 shēng: old surnames came from the mother's line

cards.Example: 他在树下睡觉。 tā zài shù xià shuìjiào: He's sleeping under the tree.
cards.Notes: 木 tree + 对 duì

cards.Example: 快来! kuài lái: Come quick!
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 夬; the same right side gives the sound in 块 kuài and 筷 kuài

cards.Example: 我不怕。 wǒ bú pà: I'm not scared.
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 白 bái, sound shifted to pà

cards.Example: 我忘记了。 wǒ wàngjì le: I forgot.
cards.Notes: 忘 = 亡 wáng over 心 heart; 记 = 讠 + 己 jǐ (己 vs 已 yǐ)

cards.Example: 我有钱了! wǒ yǒu qián le: I've got money now!
cards.Notes: 钅 metal (coins) + 戋 on the right

cards.Example: 我去银行。 wǒ qù yínháng: I'm going to the bank.
cards.Notes: 银 = 钅 metal + 艮; 行 is háng here but xíng in 不行
请 and 清: same 青 sound part, 讠 speech vs 氵 water

cards.Meaning: He's afraid Mom will scold him.
cards.Notes: 妈 and 骂 share 马 for the sound; 女 vs 口口 for meaning

cards.Pinyin: wǒ wàngjì tā de hàomǎ le
cards.Notes: 忘 has 心 underneath: forgetting happens in the mind
